geographic_evidence.description: Autumn tranquility and meditation in the Japanese Garden, Moscow. Chashitsu is a house for tea ceremonies, an indispensable attribute of a Japanese tea garden. The Japanese Garden is located on the territory of the Main Botanical Garden of the Academy of Sciences. It was opened in 1987 and is a gift from the Government of Japan to the Government of the USSR. This Japanese Garden is the only Japanese garden in Russia created by Japanese landscape architects and gardeners. Renowned landscape architect Ken Nakajima oversaw the creation of the garden.
